summary.text: At level-cap and Warmaster readiness, the champion crosses all four outer continents to secure the eight gems under temporary, contested, duplicate-safe custody before Edras can force the wish.

chapter.progressionIntent: A long-form party and RvR campaign; side quests improve diplomacy and clarity but never replace level, gear, points, or objective requirements.

summary.text: Complete the Warmaster path, become True Warmaster, and secure all eight gem signatures through legitimate warzone objectives and realm custody accords.

text.text: Reach the level-50 readiness requirement through valid progression.
Complete required Warmaster gear and Warzone-point objectives.
Earn True Warmaster status through the approved realm contract.
Secure all eight gems or their committed custody signatures without duplication.
Survive legitimate realm counterplay and restore any lost custody state.
Use the eightfold resonance to reveal Accordant Isle.

summary.text: Reject a solitary sky-throne and use Stonehold's oaths to negotiate shared gem custody.
Turn the celestial glade into a meeting ground rather than a claim of supremacy.
Refuse an empire built on forced radiance and place the Sunseal under witnessed custody.
Break the empty throne's claim that only shadow can survive the coming convergence.

choice.meaning: Choose battle-first, diplomacy-first, or mixed routes per rival realm; every route still requires valid objective participation and acknowledged temporary custody.

mainQuest.completionOutcome: All eight gems are accounted for under temporary custody, True Warmaster status is earned rather than granted, and Accordant Isle becomes reachable.

summary.text: Protect and question a captured thief who believed Edras's agents were preventing a rival realm from ending the world.

sideQuests.unlockCondition: At least four gem signatures secured

mainStoryContribution.text: Shows how Edras weaponized partial truths and makes gem theft a political tragedy rather than a simple collectible loop.

text.text: Protect the prisoner from both revenge and extraction.
Compare the thief's orders with Veil cipher evidence.
Record a voluntary testimony for all four custodians.
The thief testifies at the custody council and changes one rival commander's response.

summary.text: Draft a temporary eight-gem custody accord with representatives from all four realms.

sideQuests.unlockCondition: At least six gem signatures secured

mainStoryContribution.text: Explicitly explains why the player may carry or synchronize rival gems without conquering their realms or permanently owning their sacred objects.

text.text: Hear each realm's non-negotiable custody condition.
Draft return, loss, theft, and duplicate-delivery clauses.
Secure witnessed signatures without forcing assent.
The accord prevents one optional confrontation on Accordant Isle; final-wish access remains unchanged.
